text: I can name the control plane and node components and explain what keeps working when the control plane is down.
I can calculate the pod count, minimum capacity and duration of a rolling update from replicas, maxSurge and maxUnavailable.
I can explain how a Service routes to ready pods, why long-lived gRPC connections stay unbalanced and what an Ingress needs to work.
I can design liveness, readiness and startup probes plus graceful shutdown for a service, and say what each must not check.
I can apply the HPA formula, estimate how long new capacity takes to arrive and say what absorbs a spike instead.
I can argue for and against Kubernetes for a given team and list what an interviewer expects me to know about it.
